headline: Grand Theft Auto VI First-Day Sales Reach $3.8 Billion, Rockstar Says
summary: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day of release. The publisher described the launch as the largest in entertainment history.
why: Rockstar Games is a video game publisher and subsidiary of US-based Take-Two Interactive Software. The Grand Theft Auto franchise is one of the most commercially successful media properties globally.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
impacts.why: Take-Two Interactive is the parent company of Rockstar Games, which launched Grand Theft Auto VI to record opening-day sales.
